description:
The hints line in the /tree overlay is incomplete compared to upstream.

## Current

```
↑/↓: move. ←/→: page. ^←/^→ or Alt+←/Alt+→: fold/branch
```

## Upstream

```
↑/↓: move. ←/→: page. ^←/^→ or Alt+←/Alt+→: fold/branch. shift+l: label. ctrl+d/ctrl+t/ctrl+u/ctrl+l/ctrl+a: filters (ctrl+o: cycle)
```

## Missing content

- `shift+l: label` — label editing keybinding hint
- `ctrl+d/ctrl+t/ctrl+u/ctrl+l/ctrl+a: filters` — direct filter mode keybinding hints
- `(ctrl+o: cycle)` — filter cycle keybinding hint

## Where to fix

`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex`, `render/2`:
- Update the hardcoded hints string in the second line of the render output

## Verification

Open /tree and confirm the second line shows the full keybinding hints including label and filter shortcuts.
title: /tree hints line: add label and filter keybinding hints
